affected.note: Up to 7,782,009 yumeCard member records (joined on/before 2024-02-15); plus up to 2,990 Izumi Techno part-time applicants; group mail server history destroyed (count unknown). Company says leak 'extremely unlikely' but viewing cannot be ruled out.

summary.en: Supermarket operator Izumi, which runs the Youme Town and Youme Mart chains, suffered a system failure on 2024-02-15 after ransomware encrypted servers across its group, with attackers entering through a VPN device. No leak was found, but it said data of up to 7,782,009 yumeCard member records, including names, birthdates, addresses and phone numbers, may have been viewed.
summary.ja: ゆめタウンやゆめマートを展開するイズミは、2024年2月15日にグループの複数サーバがランサムウェアで暗号化されシステム障害が発生した。侵入経路はVPN機器とされ、流出の痕跡は見つかっていないが、ゆめカード会員の氏名、生年月日、住所、電話番号など最大7,782,009件が参照された可能性があると公表した。
